title: Artifact Library PSR Candidate Type 001
summary: A portable Product-Semantic Record bundle for dogfooding the planned Artifact Library store.

observed: The packet contains Markdown, manifests, revision notes, rendered HTML, and a seed script reference.
The packet is repository-local and reviewable without a live server.
proposed: The future artifact-store CLI should ingest this packet atomically.
The artifact server/store should emit a durable receipt after successful ingestion.
blocked: Live ingestion is blocked until the planned artifact-store CLI exists.
